lines.text: Five checks between a claim and your production.
An agent claims tests passed. Before that claim moves anything — the evidence faces the gate.
Present — the artifact exists. Fresh — inside the window. Bound — to the exact commit. Hash-intact and signed — by a key we trust. Positive — it actually says pass.
All five hold — admit. The lifecycle advances.
Now watch what it stops. Stale evidence — halted. Bound to the wrong commit — halted. Tampered bytes — halted. A forged signature — halted. A passing report of a failing suite — halted.
Every halt carries a machine-readable recovery. The agent corrects itself, and tries again.
Five checks. No evidence — no advance. var-runtime. Proof-or-Stop.
